title: Constitution Baseline
description: The pinned reference point for constitutional drift detection. Deliberately re-pinned via RECON_PIN_CONSTITUTION=1, never written by an observation run. Its absence or corruption must be an observable state, not a silent skip — a watchdog whose reference point can vanish without comment is blind in the way that looks healthy.

constitutional_files.description: Path to SHA-256 of the exact file bytes at the pinned commit

pinned_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the deliberate re-pin
